item.title: Ggml v1.0.0
item.description:
📝 Filter Loading Sorry, something went wrong. com and signed with GitHub’s verified signature. API changes Pruned deprecated API and removed the legacy DIAG_MASK_INF/DIAG_MASK_ZERO ops, bumping the RPC protocol to reject incompatible peers (llama/29801, llama/31946) Added ggml_rope_set_truncate/ggml_rope_get_truncate to control YaRN correction-bound rounding (llama/30206, llama/30802) Implemented the backward pass for TRI (llama/30712) Added MUL_MAT src1 precision tests and gating for ggml_prec_set_acc (llama/31896, llama/31851) Bumped the RPC protocol to v9 with faster loading and graceful failure on unreachable endpoints or failed handshakes (llama/29413, llama/30415) Core changes Scheduler skips uploading inputs that are not read and prefetches only inputs produced by earlier splits (llama/31419, llama/32100) MoE cache can compute a share of the cache misses on the CPU and copy the results back asynchronously (llama/30966) Meta backend raises the compute view limit for buffers with few tensors (llama/31447) Backend changes CUDA Added few-row MMQ for batch sizes 2-24 and MMVF for BF16 few-row matmuls (llama/31533, llama/31959) Added OCP FP8 support and fused NVFP4 gate/up matmuls with GLU in MMQ (llama/28413, llama/31296) Extended FlashAttention with an sm70 head-size-256 config and MMA head sizes 40/72 (llama/27997, llama/30285) Improved graph handling: skip compat checks on reuse, re-instantiate on cluster-dim changes, move graph state (llama/32004, llama/31284, llama/32001) MoE: skip empty MMQ stream-k tiles, linearize the MoE layout, and sanitize post-bias NaNs (llama/32067, llama/31047, llama/31005) Added a debug buffer pool and halved the VMM pool reservation with reserve retries (llama/31919, llama/30542) HIP: use a fixed BLAS workspace and add an MFMA lightning indexer for CDNA2 (llama/31838, llama/29050) Added a d_state=64 SSM_SCAN fast path and made radix Top-K deterministic for ties (llama/31818, llama/31084) Metal Fused MoE routing and kept fusable node groups inside a single command buffer (llama/31615, llama/31688) Made radix Top-K deterministic for ties, added mul_mm for 32<=K<64, and switched TRI to select (llama/31084, llama/30982, llama/30711) Fixed GROUP_NORM for ne03>1 and out-of-bounds accesses in the FA output and SOLVE_TRI kernels (llama/31852, llama/31662, llama/32103) Vulkan Added an Intel FlashAttention prefill kernel (llama/29357) Added batched tensor copies, a test-fusion interface, and ReBAR detection (llama/31418, llama/30769, llama/31658) Enabled dequantized KV with CM2, YaRN truncation, RDNA3/4 large-tile split-K, and large coopmat matmul on newer AMD drivers (llama/31526, llama/30802, llama/30280, llama/31587) Added a tiled-transpose concat shader and FWHT kernels for block widths above 512 (llama/30591, llama/29772) Fixed MoltenVK out-of-bounds accesses, GROUP_NORM workgroup limits, and FA scratch sizing (llama/31890, llama/31930, llama/30487) Capped scalar FlashAttention at 8 rows for large heads on Qualcomm (llama/30829) SYCL Added a device-side MoE scheduler (llama/30156) Made the oneDNN FA cache thread-safe and un-gated fused SDPA for Alchemist at head_dim=64 (llama/31138, llama/31574) Cached the device id and reject buffers that would exceed VRAM (llama/31126, llama/32013, llama/31285) Added exact rounding for CPY to Q4_1/Q5_1/Q8_0, strided CLAMP, and f16 SWIGLU_OAI (llama/31465, llama/31784, llama/30857) Fixed AOT for allocations above 4GB (llama/31873) OpenCL Added decomposed Adreno FlashAttention and improved decode performance (llama/32046, llama/31633) Added q6_k tiled, q8_0, and f32/q5_k multi-column GEMV kernels and f32 MUL_MAT_ID (llama/31758, llama/30947, llama/31783) Added arange, non-contiguous sigmoid, repeat for f16/i32/i16/bf16, and DSV4 HC pre/post kernels (llama/31829, llama/31687, llama/31782, llama/31623) Enabled multi-column GEMV by default for Adreno X2 (llama/31694) WebGPU Added batched tensor API support and returned maxBufferSize from get_max_size (llama/31473, llama/31348) Added GROUP_NORM, MEAN, COUNT_EQUAL, and PAD_REFLECT_1D kernels (llama/31490, llama/31591, llama/31578, llama/31877) Supported the YaRN truncation config (llama/30802) Hexagon Added Q.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases/tag/v1.0.0
